riesgo.descripcion: This Quality Defect Report is for High Efficiency Particulate Air (HEPA) filter integrity test failures for Respreeza and Sterile Water for Injection (sWFI, undergoes terminal sterilization following filling) manufactured in Building 3/22 in Kankakee. When tested on 09-12 November 2020, at the start of the B3/22 facility shutdown, certain HEPA filters supplying air to the filling, lyophilizer loading, and equipment staging suites used for the processing of these products did not meet integrity testing requirements.
